subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, release behavior, docs, and tests intentionally keep key-free providers explicit because the choice changes outbound search routing without a credential signal.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep the current provider-selection policy and solve the remaining UX gap through diagnostics, setup guidance, or docs instead of automatic routing.

options.title: Approve Full Reversal
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only if the linked implementation updates all sibling decision surfaces and includes real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause The Candidate
options.body: Leave the issue and PR open until a product/security owner sponsors a narrower direction or closes the policy change as not planned.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Keep the current provider-selection policy and solve the remaining UX gap through diagnostics, setup guidance, or docs instead of automatic routing.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue and its linked PR would reverse.
